claims.disproof_condition: Revise if the FCC removes or amends this Covered List category, grants a relevant Conditional Approval, or changes the equipment-authorization consequences.
claims.statement: On 2026-07-28, the FCC added foreign-produced advanced robotic devices to the Covered List, except devices granted a Department of War Conditional Approval; covered equipment cannot receive new FCC equipment authorizations.

source_doc.permission_basis: 美國聯邦政府 FCC 官方 Public Notice；依 17 U.S.C. §105 為 public domain，本 action 僅保存核對所需的有限節錄。
source_doc.publisher: Federal Communications Commission, Public Safety and Homeland Security Bureau
source_doc.title: FCC Public Notice DA 26-786 — Foreign-Produced Advanced Robotic Devices Added to Covered List

sources.locator: Public Notice DA 26-786, p.2, Covered List update
sources.quote: Foreign-produced advanced robotic devices, except advanced robotic devices which have been granted a Conditional Approval by DoW.

sources.locator: Public Notice DA 26-786, p.2, Equipment Authorization Impacts
sources.quote: Under the Commission's existing rules in section 2.903(a), once added to the Covered List, covered equipment is prohibited from receiving equipment authorizations.
